Name: Animated Minecraft Netherportal (CP-A)
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]This mod changes the Obelisks to look like Netherportals.

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿
3. Download the mod anywhere and then unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.



[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]

You can edit the config.json to choose one of the following styles: classic, extra

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HzRvMpB.png[/img]

A preview of the animation:
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5Tbo6Al.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]

﻿[/center]

Manifest.Name: CP-A - Netherportal Obelisk
Manifest.Description: Replaces the obelisks with an animated Netherportal.
